allowTapWhenOffline.description: Allows you to Tap the button while offline

bottomSheetHeading.description: An optional heading to display in the secondary bottom sheet header.

onCloseBottomSheet.description: Callback that is called when the secondary actions bottom sheet is closed.

onOpenBottomSheet.description: Callback that is called when the secondary actions bottom sheet is opened.

showCancelInBottomSheet.description: Display a cancel button in the secondary bottom sheet footer.

buttonVariation.description: Themes the action button to the type of action it performs (default: "work")

customButton.description: Optional custom button that can be rendered in place of the primary action button

icon.description: Icon to be displayed on the action button

iconColor.description:
Determines the color of the icon. If not specified, some icons have a default system colour which will be used
Others that don't have a system colour fall back to greyBlue.
Only applies the iconColor to ButtonGroup.PrimaryAction when it is rendered under the "more" menu.

onPress.description: Press handler for the action button
